title: Clean Hands Pure Heart
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Clean Hands Pure Heart | Holiness, Truth, Spiritual Warfare, and Judgment - Psalm v24:3-5

Who shall ascend into the hill of the Lord? Psalm v24 answers with a searching call to live before God with clean hands and a pure heart. Truth is not optional for the believer; it is the ground we stand on, the armor we wear, and the path where mercy and righteousness are found. God does not call us to vanity, pretense, or self-rule, but to honest repentance, holy living, and a heart that longs to please Him.

From Psalm v24, Psalm v25, Psalm v26, and 1 Peter v4:17, we are reminded that judgment must begin at the house of God. The Lord examines us, teaches us, and calls us to walk in humility while resisting the enemy’s attacks. His house is to be loved, His people are to be prayed for, and our lives are to shine with obedience. In Christ, righteousness is not something we fake; it is what we seek as we submit to Him, turn from sin, and follow Him with reverent faith.
